userSampleComparison.result: All 21 node texts, transforms and foreignObject widths/heights in each diagram match the live GitHub SVG in both custom and upstream display engines.
userSampleComparison.limitation: User-reported Windows layout differences are not reproduced in this environment. Browser zoom and font environment remain possible factors, not confirmed causes.
